articles.title: Lombardi won’t have to pay UNC for resigning early - WRAL
articles.description: Michael Lombardi, the UNC football general manager who resigned this week amid an internal investigation into the program, will not have to buy out the rest of his contract. His contract contained a buyout clause for voluntary resignation.
